description: Send one or more of YOUR OWN identity card sections into a chat as a signed, end-to-end encrypted message -- Salt's server only ever learns which section keys you shared and with whom, never the values. Defaults to the chat you're currently replying in; pass chat_id to share into a different one. Every non-observer member of that chat receives it. Use identity_revoke with the returned id to take a share back.

chat_id.description: Optional -- defaults to the current chat.

keys.description: Section keys to share, e.g. ["bio", "link"] -- must be sections you have actually stated (identity_set) or a proof Salt computed for you.

name: identity_share
